hypothesis: V85 feature representations from the same raw field need within-field tree interactions; source-group interaction constraints preserve them while suppressing cross-field overfit.
unique_primary_variable: LightGBM interaction_constraints absent (A) versus fixed source-group partition (B).
baseline: V85 Naji LightGBM 148 features; 5-fold seed42 matched rerun; V100 ref56023943 Public0.94635 is online target, never replaced by weaker harness baseline.

feature_contract.source_groups: 12 raw source fields retained by V85; all derived representations assigned to exactly one origin. Explicit is_30k_spike/is_millionaire_cliff/is_dead_zone -> Annual_Income_USD; is_env_hater -> Environmental_Concern_Level. No composite keys in V85. Unknown, missing, overlapping origins fail closed.

fixed_blend.formula: 0.5 * A outer-valid raw probability + 0.5 * B outer-valid raw probability

stop_rule: If neither B nor fixed 50:50 blend has positive pooled delta and 5/5 positive folds, close this fixed P1 recipe. No bin/group/seed neighborhood rescue.
checkpoint: One atomic arm checkpoint per fold, source/config hash validated on resume.
formal_followup: Passing diagnostic triggers separately frozen 40-fold and end-to-end validation under takeover PLAN; only then conditional CLI submission.
negative_control: 2026-09-04 singleton probe used V96 113-column features and a 4x n_estimators cap, so it is not a contract-identical third arm and will not be reused as matched A/B result.
